relation.note: The subject was the son-in-law (ṣihr) of al-Shams b. Ḥāmid.

event.desc: Dismissed from his qāḍī office in Safad, on some of the occasions he held it, in connection with al-ʿAyzarī, before being reappointed.
event.note: Occurred at an unspecified date prior to Dhū al-Ḥijja 890 H. Person "al-ʿAyzarī" not yet identified/linked.

person.note: 708 アフマド・ブン・ユーヌス・アッ=シハーブ・アッ=サファディー、その地（サファド）のシャーフィイー派カーディー。シャムス・ブン・ハーミドの婿（サフル）。サファドのカーディー職に数度就き、そのうちの幾度かはアル=アイザリーの件で解任されたが、その後890年ズー・アル=ヒッジャ月に再任された。

708. Aḥmad b. Yūnus al-Shihāb al-Ṣafadī, the Shāfiʿī qāḍī of Safad. Son-in-law of al-Shams b. Ḥāmid. He held its judgeship on several occasions, being dismissed on some of them in connection with al-ʿAyzarī, then reappointed in Dhū al-Ḥijja in the year ninety (890 H).
